# netbox_provider_account (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get Provider Account by Name
data "netbox_provider_account" "example" {
    name = "AccountA"
}

// Get Provider Account by ID
data "netbox_provider_account" "example_by_id" {
    id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `provider_id` (Number)
- `tags` (Set of String)
